name: Nishidai
tagline: Otemachi in 35 minutes and Tokyo in 41 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Itabashi City, served by Toei Mita Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 35 minutes to Otemachi, 44 minutes to Shinjuku, 49 minutes to Shibuya and 55 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 3.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.3 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 3.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.2 m to 4.5 m, a difference of 2.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 5 to 10 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 5 to 10 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 高仁会戸田病院, about 32 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 戸田病院, about 33 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Mita Line.
congestion: Toei Mita Line runs at 146% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 西巣鴨→巣鴨, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 2LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishidai. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Nishidai.

neighbours.lead: Takashimadaira is ahead on quiet, but Nishidai is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Nishidai in a straight line. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Nishidai.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 赤羽西台線 (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Mita Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
